faq.q: What is included in a Marbella photoshoot yacht sunset session 2041?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You bring your own camera and talent.

faq.q: Which boats are available for a sunset photoshoot in Marbella?
faq.a: We offer a range from the Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) to the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax). For a classic look, try the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39. All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: How much does a 2-hour sunset photoshoot charter cost?
faq.a: Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours, all-inclusive. The Mangusta 80 has a 4-hour minimum at €4,719, which includes a free jet ski. Other boats: request pricing via WhatsApp.

faq.q: What time does the sunset session start in Marbella?
faq.a: Sunset times vary by season. In summer (June–August), golden hour is roughly 19:00–21:00. We recommend a 2-hour charter starting 60–90 minutes before the actual sunset to capture the best light.

faq.q: Can I bring a professional photographer and equipment?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely. There is no limit on camera gear, but please ensure the total passenger count (including photographer, models, and crew) does not exceed the boat's maximum capacity. Check your chosen boat's limit.

faq.q: Do you provide a makeup artist or stylist?
faq.a: No, we do not supply makeup artists or stylists. You are free to bring your own team. The boat has a cabin for changing and a small bathroom on most models (e.g., Azimut 58 Flybridge, Ferretti 94).

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for a sunset photoshoot charter?
faq.a: Cancellations made more than 7 days before departure receive a full refund. Within 7 days, a 50% charge applies. No-shows or same-day cancellations are non-refundable. Weather-related cancellations are rescheduled at no extra cost.

faq.q: Can I book a sunset photoshoot on the Mangusta 80?
faq.a: Yes, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is available in white or grey. The minimum charter is 4 hours at €4,719, which includes a free jet ski. Ideal for a larger production or a luxury lifestyle shoot.

data.body_html:
Capture the golden hour over the Mediterranean with a Marbella photoshoot yacht sunset session 2041. Departing from Puerto Banús, our private yacht charters give you a floating studio with uninterrupted views of La Concha mountain, the Marbella coastline, and the glittering sea. Whether you're a professional photographer, a brand shooting a campaign, or a couple wanting engagement portraits, we provide the boat, skipper, drinks, and snacks — you bring the creative vision.

Why choose a sunset photoshoot on a yacht in Marbella?

Marbella's sunset is famous for its warm light and long golden hour. From a yacht, you get 360-degree access to the horizon, with no crowds, no buildings, and no distractions. The backdrop changes every minute: from the Puerto Banús marina to the distant Sierra Blanca peaks. A 2-hour charter during sunset (typically 19:00–21:00 in summer) gives you ample time for multiple setups, outfit changes, and drone shots (drone not included).

Our fleet for your photoshoot

We offer a range of boats to suit different shoot styles and group sizes. All depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella. See our full fleet on the Boat Rental Marbella home page.

Pricing for sunset sessions

Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours, or €2,299 for 8 hours if you want a full day shoot. Both prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. The Mangusta 80 (white or grey) requires a minimum 4-hour charter at €4,719, which includes a free jet ski. For all other boats — including the Ferretti 94, Canados 86, or Maiora 26m — pricing is on request via WhatsApp. No hidden fees.

What's included in every charter

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the entire charter
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

You bring your own camera, lighting, models, and any additional props. The boat has a cabin for changing and a small bathroom on most models (e.g., Azimut 58 Flybridge, Ferretti 94).

Best locations for your shoot

Your skipper will suggest the best route based on wind and light. Popular spots include Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, and the coastline between Puerto Banús and Marbella Marina. For a skyline shot, anchor near the Golden Mile with La Concha behind you. For open water, head toward Estepona or Sotogrande (longer charters only).

How to book your sunset session

Reserve your preferred boat and date via WhatsApp. We recommend booking at least 3–5 days in advance, especially for popular sunset slots in July and August. Provide your group size, desired boat, and preferred time. We'll confirm availability and send a payment link. For more ideas, check our experiences page.
